infrastructure.backend: Dedicated Seoul Lambda, DynamoDB table, 14-day log group, OIDC deploy and runtime roles

verification.releaseConfig: Registration open. Verified dedicated Function URL, production HTTPS responses and ingestion into the shared US PostHog project.

rollback.scope: Close new signups with the dedicated service workflow and the frontend flag. Retain the Function URL and withdrawal access for existing registrations.

limits: Mailbox delivery and manual mailbox cleanup are outside the site verification. Launch mail will be sent individually by the operator.
Mobile layout used Chrome emulation. Test analytics are synthetic traffic.
previousDeploymentHistory: Git history of qa/deployment.json before this revision

posthog.verifiedWith: Project-scoped HogQL query by app, traffic kind and QA run ID

emailSignup.tests: 8 isolated backend checks passed. Production mobile browser submitted and withdrew a synthetic registration. Same-request and new-browser duplicate checks yielded one registration email attempt in total. Both requests returned HTTP 200, SES accepted the two operator messages, and a consistent read confirmed deletion of the active signup. Shared app-feedback code and revision matched the pre-release snapshot.
